purpose: Machine-readable index of all standards, procedures, templates, and memory for agent access

standards.title: Audit Framework
standards.scope: Core principles, audit standards (8 total), materiality levels

standards.title: Independence & Objectivity
standards.scope: Audit committee independence rules, conflicts of interest, recusal procedures

procedures.title: Execution Monitoring
procedures.trigger: Manual checkpoint or auto at 150% variance

procedures.title: Code Review
procedures.trigger: After code is written, before deployment

procedures.title: Quality Control of Audits
procedures.trigger: Audit report completed, before User approval

mission_planning.name: Mission PDR (Plan)
mission_planning.usage: Fill this at mission start (SessionStart hook)

mission_planning.name: Mission PDR (Example - filled)
mission_planning.usage: Reference example; shows how to complete PDR

audit_reporting.name: Mission Scorecard
audit_reporting.usage: Structured data export of audit report

code_review.name: 8-Angle Code Review Checklist
code_review.usage: Complete one angle at a time; capture findings for each

code_review.name: Code Review Finding Template
code_review.usage: Document each finding (one JSON object per bug/issue)

checklists.name: Pre-Mission Checklist
checklists.usage: Verify PDR completeness before mission starts

checklists.name: Mid-Mission Checkpoint
checklists.usage: Assess variance, escalation needs at 2-4 hour marks

checklists.name: Audit QA Checklist
checklists.usage: Second auditor review before User approval

sections.name: Audit Findings Database
sections.description: Indexed repository of all audit findings (by type, severity, root cause)
sections.query_api: agents can query by: finding_type, severity, date_range, root_cause_pattern
example_queries: Get all CONFIRMED bugs from 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-19

sections.name: Lessons Learned Catalog
sections.description: Actionable insights from past audits; what we learned and will do differently
sections.example: 2026-06-19: Top 3 improvements from LOGHOUSE mission — (1) explicit PDR upfront, (2) mid-mission checkpoint, (3) pre-commit code review

sections.name: Risk Register
sections.description: Cumulative risk register from all missions; recurring risks that keep emerging
sections.example: Timeline estimation off by >50%: probability=high, impact=high, mitigation='explicit estimation review + buffer'

sections.name: Common Blockers & Mitigations
sections.description: Patterns of blockers that recur; proven mitigations for each
sections.example: Blocker: External API timeout. Frequency: 2/5 missions. Mitigation: Implement retry + circuit breaker

sections.name: Bug Patterns by Phase
sections.description: Which types of bugs appear in which mission phases? (planning, execution, testing, deployment)
sections.example: Off-by-one errors appear 60% in execution phase → recommend range-based testing in SOP-003

sections.name: Team Efficiency Benchmarks
sections.description: Historical performance data: timeline variance, scope expansion, bug rates, parallelization efficiency
sections.example: Average timeline variance: 35% (p75); target: <30%. Trend: improving (+3% per quarter)

agent_access.description: How agents can access registry and memory

examples: Find all CONFIRMED bugs in findings-database.json with status='CONFIRMED' AND severity='critical'
Get lessons-learned.md entries from last 7 days sorted by priority

template_loading.description: Agents can load templates by file path
template_loading.example: Agent loads templates/mission-pdr-template.md to present PDR structure to User
template_loading.format_support: markdown and JSON templates; agents parse as needed

quarterly_review.schedule: End of every quarter (Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, Dec 31)
metrics_analyzed: Bug rate per mission (target: <3 CONFIRMED per mission)
